_about: Per-program-brand constants for the program card (rendering contract v1.7, design of record docs/design/program-card-design-v1.md). READ, NEVER COMPUTED AT RENDER TIME - the endcap's brand bar, the mirrored stage wash and the subtitle tint all key off `color` here. `mark` null means the tree has no art for this brand: the endcap renders `short_title` as a typographic mark on the charcoal tile instead, and the brand is an open item for the marks pipeline. `provisional: true` means the COLOUR is a placeholder too - nothing in this repo could be derived from, and a network's brand hex typed from memory is an invented fact.

gameday.title: College GameDay
gameday.color_source: docs/design/program-card-design-v1.md - Home Depot orange, Joe's ruling; replaces the mark-derived red
gameday.mark_source: web/public/programs/college-gameday.png, built through scripts/build_brand_marks.py (hf 1.150, recipe 'RAW - sponsor block removed, shield rebuilt; dark body reads by rim + white text'). The art was published 2026-09-02 and nothing referenced it until prompt 52 stage 6 - a wiring bug, not a sourcing problem. `mark` stays null: program brands publish ONE file, already processed for a dark context, where league brands publish a raw/_dark pair; and only `mark_dark` is ever read (ProgramCard.js:73, MobileGrid.js:764). Wiring the mark does NOT re-derive the colour - #F96302 is Joe's explicit Home Depot ruling. For the record, re-deriving from this mark by the documented rule gives #D11222, which is exactly 'the mark-derived red' the ruling replaced.

aew.title: AEW
aew.color_source: docs/design/program-card-design-v1.md - the non-red proof against the all-red cluster. NOT A USE OF THE --gold TOKEN: this hex was byte-identical to the OLD web/app/globals.css --gold (#f0c850), which prompt 52 stage 3 moved to the metallic #C6AF7A. AEW KEEPS #F0C850 - it is a brand constant, and a find-and-replace on the hex would silently repaint a brand.

bignoon.title: Big Noon Kickoff
bignoon.color_source: derived from web/public/programs/big-noon-kickoff.png - dominant saturated hue bucket (195-210deg), 56.6% of opaque pixels, median chroma. The same rule that derived indycar, with one difference worth stating: indycar was derived from a RAW league mark, and the only published Big Noon art is the DARK-CONTEXT build, whose recipe is 'floor_l 0.55 (FOX blue lifted)'. So the HUE is FOX's; the lightness is the recipe's, which is what this colour is used on - a bar and a seam on charcoal.
bignoon.note: PROVISIONAL CLEARED 2026-09-06 (prompt 52 stage 6). The old note read 'no mark in the tree; FOX's cached wordmark is monochrome, so no colour to derive' - and that was FALSE by then: the mark was in the tree, and it is 70.9% saturated pixels. The note described FOX's cached WORDMARK, a different asset from this show's lockup.
bignoon.mark_source: web/public/programs/big-noon-kickoff.png, built through scripts/build_brand_marks.py (hf 1.079). Published 2026-09-02 and referenced by nothing until prompt 52 stage 6.
